A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
